title: Contracted katakana: R, G and J rows — write in kana
description: Use a Latin-letter spelling cue and base sign to distinguish small ャ/ュ/ョ from full-sized kana.

exercises.prompt: Type the contracted katakana rya using the リ base sign and a small kana. Do not use a full-sized kana.
exercises.explanation: リャ is the contracted rya spelling. Small ャ joins リ; リヤ uses full-sized ヤ. These written forms are not interchangeable.
